reviewer: Root, independent second AI-assisted reader; not the primary author
decision: All74 retained pairs for73 distinct source verses accepted without primary edits.

target_reading_evidence.additional_full_context: 2 Samuel7:8–16,9 complete units in a360-token view with end marker

specific_checks: Grace-not-in-vain, no-stumbling, hardship catalogues and ministry paradoxes have specific textual counterparts without merging all named circumstances.

Leviticus26:12 walking/God/people and Ezekiel37:27 dwelling-among-them are two separately supported components for6:16, counted as two pairs and one completed source. Leviticus26:11 actual covenant is not misquoted as dwelling.
2 Samuel wider context explicitly identifies David and his coming royal seed. The Father/son promise is compared with Corinthians plural sons AND daughters without making the formulations identical.
Beliar, singular versus plural participant labels, actual we-appeal wording, and painful-correspondence context are preserved. No named wrongdoer or surviving-letter identification is invented.

Titus and Timothy messenger reports are distinguished; absence in Troas, departure to Macedonia and later comfort are not relocated. All unnamed brothers remain unnamed and are not automatically identified as one person or as Luke.

8:7 actual the-love-from-us-in-you is retained. Voluntary giving, acceptance according to means, reciprocity and collection preparation do not become a requirement that every donor give beyond means or all livelihood.
Exodus16:18 actual household gathering, Proverbs3:4 instruction, Greek Psalm111:9 gifts/age-of-an-age and Isaiah55:10 rain OR snow were checked. Quotations and differing clauses remain exact.

Sowing/reaping images, sufficiency for good works and thanksgiving are related in their stated contexts without an invented financial rate of return. The indescribable-gift comparison does not make its unnamed referent an explicitly identified physical contribution.
